overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn announced upcoming city events and community updates for September, including rescheduled park ceremonies, office hours, and weekend festivals.

items.title: Hickey Park Ribbon-Cutting Postponement
items.summary: The ribbon-cutting for the new tennis and basketball courts at Hickey Park was rescheduled to September 20 at 3 p.m. due to rain.

items.title: Mayoral Office Hours
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn announced upcoming community office hours scheduled for September 14 from 3 to 4 p.m. at CB Scoops.

items.title: Run Medford Weekend
items.summary: Run Medford weekend events will begin September 22 with the dedication of the Hormel Stadium track to Dave McGillivray alongside fun runs, followed by a five-mile race and two-mile walk on September 23.

items.title: Mystic River Celebration
items.summary: The Mystic River Celebration will take place at the Condon Shell on September 23 from 12 to 4 p.m., featuring artists, vendors, food, and live entertainment.

items.title: Medford Chamber of Commerce Oktoberfest
items.summary: The Medford Chamber of Commerce will host Oktoberfest in Medford Square on Saturday, September 30, from 1 to 5 p.m.
